Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
NetworkManager is a system network service that manages network devices and
connections, attempting to keep active network connectivity when available. Its
capabilities include managing Ethernet, wireless, mobile broadband (WWAN), and
PPPoE devices, as well as providing VPN integration with a variety of different
VPN services.

This update fixes the following bugs:

* Due to an internal race condition, an interface name in some cases became
invalid. However, NetworkManager could not deal with invalid name changes
successfully, and consequently terminated unexpectedly when they occurred. A
patch has been provided to fix this bug, and NetworkManager now works properly
on interface renaming. (BZ#1241378)

* Previously, the gateway "ping" timeout value was sometimes not respected when
the "ping" utility returned early with an error. As a consequence, the device
activation could proceed even if the gateway was not reachable yet. A patch has
been provided to fix this bug, and NetworkManager now always respects the
gateway "ping" timeout when "ping" returns an error. (BZ#1238226)

Users of NetworkManager are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which
fix these bugs.
